mapper.select: SELECT to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE AND o.created_at >= #{start} GROUP BY to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY date

SELECT c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantity FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY amount DESC
